sampling.allocation_rule: sqrt(N_h) allocation with a 25-pair floor, largest-remainder rounding to 300; not claimed to be Neyman-optimal
sampling.note: HIDDEN KEY. Do not open before annotating.

practice.type: synthetic training examples; excluded from study

stratum_definition.S1_same_answer_lexical_diff: answer_class(A) == answer_class(B) AND norm_key(A) != norm_key(B) (both KEYS present; correctness vs gold not required)
stratum_definition.S4_missing_key: norm_key(A) is None or norm_key(B) is None (one or both replies have no usable KEY); checked first so the strata stay disjoint

sampling.target_population: All stored unordered within-task record pairs in the original frame, including cross-model pairs; pair-weighted, not task-equal or model-specific.
sampling.instrument_policy: lexical includes (answer,None); key_exact undefined on missing KEY; scorer recomputes all predicates

bootstrap.design: within-stratum pair resampling; conditional on stored finite frame, not task-superpopulation uncertainty

interpretation: Primary reference: two separate 2/3 majorities, both axes decisive; positive iff both SAME.
Unresolved pairs are excluded from error denominators, never treated as negative; report coverage.
Joint same share among all pairs is resolved-positive mass; lower/upper bounds allow unresolved labels either value.
Fleiss kappa and raw agreement are unweighted descriptions of the stratified annotation sample.
False acceptance = FP/(FP+TN); false rejection = FN/(FN+TP), with stratum weights.
Controls use their own axis: answer_only vs answer; key_exact vs method.
No semantic partition, p_max, A(h), or certification probability is estimated.
Practice labels are synthetic instructional references and never enter this report.
